title: Using the sock cymbal and single versus double beat
summary: He praises the sock cymbal for keeping time and explains when to play single beat on the bass drum, as on Tiger Rag.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: You say you were taught to beat with your foot. Were you taught to beat with your left or your right foot when you were learning? Right foot, right foot. I'm right, I'm right hand and right foot.
Right foot. My left hand probably could beat with that foot to your left hand.
But I guess you could, you could, like with a sock symbol, you could use in your left foot.
The left foot is your sock symbol.
Did you, the time that you used your sock symbols, how did you like it? Well, I, I, it was hard when I first started.
But I, I think it's wonderful. Because it helps to balance the time.
Otherwise you've got something for both legs. You see, it's like, you play along. See that? That keeps the time.

See. That keeps the time. See. That keeps the time with that. Yeah. That comes in on the after beat. Come on after beat. That's the time. Got you. You can't go nowhere. comes in on the after beat. Come on after beat. You can't go nowhere.
You don't find that tiring? Huh? You don't find that to be tiring? No.

I mean you could use it, but just like anything. But I mean I think it's one of them socks in. Because if you start a certain tempo, you're going to keep that tempo. And they can't get away from it. Keep that tempo. You got that hook there working with this hook. Ain't nobody going to run away from it. I tell them go ahead and run.
Well where do you use it? Do you use it all through the piece or just whenever you... All through the piece.

All through. Not unless you're playing like a tiger rag or something like that. I mean that you're going to... You see a different sub song you get there you play that socks in where you work your socks in. Where you get tiger rag or them scarp-jarp numbers or something like that. You're going to... Your work is that box, that little box there. That snapper. That's where you're going to work. And you ain't going to work no double four. You're going to work single beat. Because you can't make all that with that. Because they ain't going to sound like nothing. It's not giving no effect to the music. If you play... If you play a double beat on the numbers like this, well it don't give no effect to the music. You play tiger rag and you play with a double beat. And they don't give no effect if you're drumming on the snare drum. That's right. Because that's what is driving what you're making on the snare drum. Yeah, yeah. But... A lot of fellas don't play with it. Why? Because I know why.
I'm going to tell you why. Because there's nothing down there. Can't make no roll.
Anything sound... I ain't a drummer. Anybody can make noise, but not anybody can't play a drummer.
